name: inf-mega-alpha-lineup
note: L10 final boss asset: the Mega Alpha (inf.mega-alpha, static rest pose) beside the Alpha (inf.alpha) and the courier for scale, at the game camera. Look for: the SAME height as the Alpha (PO 10-15) but visibly heavier and darker, hunch mass behind the head, bone-white spine ridge, scar slashes, the oversized right arm (character right), glowing eyes, feet on the ground, no flat panels, shredded or perforated LODs. Run with --matrix to see the high and low tier at zoom 1 and 0.5.
